spatial-u2e7ff464bafbe2d61a-1.text: developing deep timber processing oriented toward the domestic market through technological re-equipment of the forestry industry and creating production facilities for high-value-added metal products;

spatial-u69fd63a81e88194beb-1.text: ensuring the economic security of Kaliningrad Oblast, including through:

spatial-u327cfbc71f447f2fd6-1.text: developing advanced processing industries oriented toward consumers within the region;

spatial-ubb1a7f0fd23eac2988-1.text: organizing reliable and affordable transport connections between Kaliningrad Oblast and the main territory of the country, including by subsidizing air and maritime transport organizations to ensure affordable air and sea transport for residents and organizations of Kaliningrad Oblast;

spatial-u246f2421deb43b2107-1.text: reducing the dependence of Kaliningrad Oblast’s economy on freight from other constituent entities of the Russian Federation and on imports by increasing the depth of product processing within the region.

spatial-u33f8adfd4f9ba631e8-1.text: The main development directions for the North Caucasian Federal District include:

spatial-u5be127b5bdaf9645b1-1.text: unlocking transit and logistics potential in light of the development of the North–South International Transport Corridor and improving connectivity within the North Caucasian Federal District’s transport framework;

spatial-ud6a1ad56dbbed618a4-1.text: developing the chemical and light industries, including traditional artistic crafts, machinery manufacturing and microelectronics, including through industrial clusters;

spatial-ud0cfd8398fc12258fa-1.text: unlocking tourism potential, including through health-resort, ethnocultural and agricultural tourism;

spatial-uaca0ada928d9f2b101-1.text: developing utilities infrastructure and providing the population with high-quality drinking water;

spatial-u3db0fa206348cdc751-1.text: developing the agro-industrial complex, including increasing value added through deeper processing of the raw material base, and improving the competitiveness of rural economies;

spatial-uba3fb43c1db8483ff6-1.text: ensuring labor market balance, including by formalizing undeclared employment, reducing unemployment and training personnel in accordance with the district economy’s needs, taking account of the current structural imbalance in vocational training and the actual demographic situation.

spatial-u6b6f4e049e3fcd9264-1.text: The main development directions for the Siberian Federal District include:

spatial-u5144363880e5731b49-1.text: ensuring sustained improvement in the quality of life, including through new investment and infrastructure projects, modernization of coal and nonferrous metallurgy production, modernization of utilities infrastructure, conversion of heat sources to more environmentally friendly fuels, and improvement of the urban environment;

spatial-ueeda2cfa8f66b15524-1.text: creating production chains and advanced-processing industrial clusters oriented toward local raw materials, primarily timber, coal, oil, natural gas, precious metals, aluminum and other nonferrous metals, and agricultural raw materials;

spatial-u8ac7367c3a7820146e-1.text: removing infrastructure constraints to ensure cross-border and interregional links in the Siberian Federal District, including by bringing the core federal road network up to regulatory standards, developing and reconstructing trunk railways, including the Eastern Railway Network of the Russian Federation, and constructing and reconstructing airport complexes;

spatial-u7c785894d9c6dc0f06-1.text: meeting the electricity and capacity needs of economic growth, developing a balanced pricing policy for energy-intensive consumers, primarily digital-currency miners, and ensuring sustained growth in gasification coverage to meet the growing needs of production and the population;

spatial-ua81768197737d12b4b-1.text: developing priority tourism territories in the Siberian Federal District, including tourism activities in Kemerovo Oblast–Kuzbass, the Republic of Khakassia and the Republic of Tuva, and creating tourism infrastructure;

spatial-uc9d1bf8accfc666a59-1.text: developing aircraft manufacturing, the chemical industry and related production;

spatial-u3b9a300cfd6c79bf81-1.text: realizing scientific and educational potential to expand the use of knowledge-intensive technologies, improve labor productivity and train in-demand personnel with high and the highest qualifications oriented toward Siberia’s development.

spatial-u86186f4532296278fd-1.text: The main development directions for the Urals Federal District include:

spatial-u3b7e1aa3859cab59df-1.text: reducing the dependence of the Urals Federal District’s economy on hydrocarbon extraction and encouraging advanced processing industries, including by using the existing raw material base as a foundation for production chains and the development of petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, oilfield services and machinery manufacturing;

spatial-u0c4ad6632d01de2453-1.text: ensuring balance in regional labor markets and reducing population outflows, including by increasing the share of high-productivity jobs and optimizing the structure of personnel training, taking account of the needs of the Urals Federal District’s economy relating to the achievement of technological independence, the transition to technologies with less adverse impact on the environment and climate, and the reclamation of exhausted mineral deposit sites;

spatial-u8386d57674d1b2611c-1.text: developing heavy engineering sectors, including machine-tool building, railway engineering and tank manufacturing, and reorienting defense-industrial enterprises toward civilian production after the end of the special military operation, by providing industrial support mechanisms and developing preferential regimes;

spatial-uc4cccfef0fac9cdce0-1.text: developing transport infrastructure, including the Northern Sea Route and the seaports, airports, river and land transport links associated with it;

spatial-u6f3902cc6aae2b9b47-1.text: realizing scientific and production potential and efficiently using the existing scientific base, primarily in oil and gas, petrochemicals, aerospace, energy and robotics, and in projects and sectors associated with development of the Arctic Zone of the Russian Federation.

spatial-u83a86ad85354eb247a-1.text: The main development directions for the Central Federal District include:

spatial-ub9c2848cbbee150b43-1.text: developing transport infrastructure between constituent entities of the Russian Federation within the Central Federal District and the Moscow urban agglomeration to convert migration from adjacent constituent entities of the Russian Federation into commuting;

spatial-uae29b1afecbe59b1cc-1.text: developing small cities and historic settlements, including to enhance the tourism attractiveness of territories in the Central Federal District, by supporting and developing such cities and settlements through removal of constraints caused by insufficient transport and tourism infrastructure, restoration of attractions, development of tourist routes to individual sites, and elimination of personnel shortages;

spatial-uc5ac255feb987bcd43-1.text: accelerating economic growth in territories bordering Ukraine, namely Belgorod, Bryansk and Kursk Oblasts, including by restoring infrastructure damaged by shelling and developing support measures for affected organizations;

spatial-u73ec83720b6d41fa30-1.text: developing the supply-side economy, including high-technology production in pharmacology and biomedicine, microelectronics and nuclear energy, through contracts with reciprocal investment obligations (offset contracts) and the creation of high-productivity jobs;

spatial-u3f99f4563e0b5218dd-1.text: creating education and production centers (clusters), including in the chemical industry, machinery manufacturing, the fuel and energy complex, radioelectronics, construction, agriculture and information technology.

spatial-ud002fd378463b03e42-1.text: The main development directions for the Southern Federal District include:

spatial-u58df0f0cf074ac05a4-1.text: developing rail, road and inland water transport infrastructure in the Azov–Black Sea region, including by developing infrastructure of the North–South International Transport Corridor and bringing the Volgograd–Astrakhan and Astrakhan–state border with the Republic of Kazakhstan roads up to regulatory standards, creating and developing near and distant road approaches to the Crimean Bridge, developing exits to the Azov and Black Sea coasts, and increasing the throughput capacity of railway approaches to Azov–Black Sea Basin ports;

spatial-u00844c48fc394ffcac-1.text: developing machinery manufacturing, metallurgy, shipbuilding and ship repair, including through industrial clusters;

spatial-u660664ee2a26f77122-1.text: providing infrastructure to meet growing demand for domestic tourism, including by increasing accommodation capacity in accordance with the interregional territorial and spatial tourism planning scheme for the Crimean Peninsula;

spatial-u17f702d53cd6031428-1.text: reducing energy shortages and removing grid constraints, including by constructing new generating capacity in the southwestern part of the South Interconnected Power System following competitive capacity selection for new generating facilities;

spatial-ua7314295abec87b87d-1.text: modernizing and constructing utilities systems and treatment facilities in light of growing tourist flows;

spatial-u9e0a8c17f707ebf721-1.text: developing the agro-industrial complex as a key driver of the Southern Federal District’s economy, including through digitalization of agricultural production, the use of unmanned aerial systems and preservation of the fertility of agricultural land in use;

spatial-u7e5b4eea9552a72d10-1.text: synchronizing development of the constituent entities of the Southern Federal District and the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including by ensuring unified approaches to planning tourism, industry, energy, transport and utilities infrastructure as part of development of the Azov Sea region.

spatial-ud7c1f60eb35122ed81-1.text: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
spatial-ud7c1f60eb35122ed81-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-u6ec9a212524f859a48-1.text: The main development directions for the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation are:
spatial-u6ec9a212524f859a48-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-ud2b847e4fe74bfa3ed-1.text: integrating the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation into the country’s common economic space, including the unified core transport network, and ensuring a quality of life no lower than the Russian average, taking account of the state program of the Russian Federation “Restoration and Socioeconomic Development of the Donetsk People’s Republic, the Lugansk People’s Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast and Kherson Oblast”; this includes creating a unified economic space in the Azov Sea region by 2028 through transport connectivity between the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, the Republic of Crimea and the city of Sevastopol and the constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the Sea of Azov and other constituent entities bordering the aforementioned territories, namely Krasnodar Krai and Belgorod, Voronezh and Rostov Oblasts;
spatial-ud2b847e4fe74bfa3ed-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-u1f6535bc1fb5fcdb07-1.text: restoring housing and utilities, transport, social, innovation and other infrastructure, including restoring and ensuring uninterrupted operation of electricity grid infrastructure and providing operating organizations with emergency stocks of materials and equipment to ensure stable electricity supply to all categories of consumers;
spatial-u1f6535bc1fb5fcdb07-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-ua66f7ee4073aa5f0e4-1.text: reducing shortages of qualified personnel through network-based educational programs aligned with promising economic sectors of the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking account of their authorities’ assessment of the need for state-funded study places and providing special reduced-rate lending terms for applicants;
spatial-ua66f7ee4073aa5f0e4-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-u8b95626761509daddf-1.text: developing industry, including metallurgy and machinery manufacturing, among other things by leasing promising coal industry enterprises to investors and decommissioning inefficient and loss-making enterprises with difficult mining and geological conditions and/or hazards from sudden outbursts and gas, which carry high risks of accidents and incidents;
spatial-u8b95626761509daddf-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-u26d7785d1461cad8bf-1.text: developing the Azov Sea tourism and recreation cluster and resorts on the Black Sea coast, including priority forms of tourism: health-resort, water-based, yachting, agricultural and automotive tourism;
spatial-u26d7785d1461cad8bf-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-ucda9fc8925cf9efaae-1.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

spatial-u3d86b79a89d9b3f720-1.text: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
spatial-u3d86b79a89d9b3f720-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u4f4e6e0eab020fa388-1.text: Risks to the spatial development of the Russian Federation are associated with the continuation of trends through 2030, including accelerated concentration of economic activity and population in urban agglomerations, deterioration of the demographic situation and worsening personnel shortages.
spatial-u4f4e6e0eab020fa388-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u050a583b68bde32bea-1.text: Along with a possible deterioration in external economic conditions, spatial development risks will complicate achievement of both the national goals and spatial development target indicators.
spatial-u050a583b68bde32bea-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u3e3ddaeaf1124441e8-1.text: To monitor and minimize these risks, measures in spatial development must be coordinated, trends in spatial development target indicators and performance of the Strategy’s tasks must be monitored, and, where necessary, the Strategy and its implementation action plan must be updated in a timely manner.
spatial-u3e3ddaeaf1124441e8-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u66bbaf6a0e7e99a48e-1.text: Taking account of these risks, the Strategy provides for 2 scenarios of spatial development of the Russian Federation: inertial and target.
spatial-u66bbaf6a0e7e99a48e-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u8fc64d176d183e3802-1.text: The inertial scenario of spatial development of the Russian Federation assumes continuation of established spatial development trends, including the settlement system and the territorial organization of the economy.
spatial-u8fc64d176d183e3802-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-ub96346376a2eb47f9a-1.text: The target scenario of spatial development of the Russian Federation assumes achievement of the spatial development goal through performance of the spatial development tasks provided for in the Strategy.
spatial-ub96346376a2eb47f9a-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-ucd4e7c09b455691108-1.text: Progress in performing those tasks is assessed through the system of spatial development target indicators.
spatial-ucd4e7c09b455691108-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-ue5007dbe4bf5c2e336-1.text: Spatial development target indicators have been calculated in accordance with the inertial and target scenarios provided for in Annex No. 1 to the Strategy.
spatial-ue5007dbe4bf5c2e336-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-u3d7022bb9785079d70-1.text: The main mechanisms for implementing the Strategy provided for in Section XI of the Strategy are used to achieve the spatial development target indicators.
spatial-u3d7022bb9785079d70-1.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

spatial-ue66e9a5ea248145cf4-1.text: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
spatial-ue66e9a5ea248145cf4-1.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u614c8d0a1f08b44e42-1.text: To identify priority mechanisms for implementing the Strategy, the results of spatial development mechanisms of the Russian Federation used before 2025 have been analyzed.
spatial-u614c8d0a1f08b44e42-1.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-ua223f6d2ec22590acb-1.text: Combined use of those mechanisms, including state programs, national projects, individual development programs for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and infrastructure budget loans, has achieved significant results in addressing spatial development tasks of the Russian Federation, including overcoming infrastructure constraints of federal significance, reducing interregional socioeconomic disparities and ensuring national security through the development of geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation.
spatial-ua223f6d2ec22590acb-1.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u5c52c9785178c3760e-1.text: The spatial development mechanisms of the Russian Federation used before 2025 remain relevant. At the same time, to address the spatial development tasks of the Russian Federation defined by the Strategy, the spatial development priorities reflected in the Strategy and the need to concentrate resources on developing anchor settlements must be enshrined in regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and of its constituent entities under which national projects, state programs and other infrastructure development instruments are implemented.
spatial-u5c52c9785178c3760e-1.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-ue8be0e7be8e8985d00-1.text: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation
spatial-ue8be0e7be8e8985d00-1.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation

spatial-uea2f3c25015ac71083-1.text: The action plan for implementing the Strategy is developed for the period of its implementation and contains a list of the most important socially significant measures, with implementation deadlines and responsible implementers. The Strategy is implemented in a single stage.
spatial-uea2f3c25015ac71083-1.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation

spatial-uaca1018c15dcc2bd5f-1.text: The plan’s measures are intended to ensure that spatial development principles and tasks are taken into account in implementing state policy, including in preparing and implementing strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation, other program documents and state support mechanisms, including through corresponding amendments to regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities.
spatial-uaca1018c15dcc2bd5f-1.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation

spatial-ub06a9fed0f501990f8-1.text: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
spatial-ub06a9fed0f501990f8-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-ufd7abc5ddc33017d19-1.text: Fulfilling the Strategy’s goal and tasks and achieving spatial development target indicators will require alignment with the Strategy of other documents aimed at the country’s socioeconomic development, including sectoral strategic planning documents, national projects and state programs.
spatial-ufd7abc5ddc33017d19-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-u0dd68c046f8673dc47-1.text: The Strategy’s provisions are taken into account in developing:
spatial-u0dd68c046f8673dc47-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-u16b1e7f64fb87b43af-1.text: strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation or its constituent entities, including sectoral strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation, socioeconomic development strategies of the federal districts and constituent entities of the Russian Federation, national projects and state programs, including the rules established in them for granting subsidies and other earmarked interbudgetary transfers;
spatial-u16b1e7f64fb87b43af-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-u4fbbb0346785de9e83-1.text: strategic planning documents for geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation, including integrated state programs developed for those territories;
spatial-u4fbbb0346785de9e83-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-ub6e25cfa402f74053d-1.text: individual development programs for constituent entities of the Russian Federation with low socioeconomic development levels, territorial development master plans, long-term socioeconomic development plans for anchor settlements, including urban agglomerations, and other documents aimed at territories’ socioeconomic development.
spatial-ub6e25cfa402f74053d-1.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

spatial-u3253c4b7ef0f4d2f00-1.text: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
spatial-u3253c4b7ef0f4d2f00-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-ub6749c29bf95907003-1.text: Priority support for the development of anchor settlements is provided on the basis of the unified list of anchor settlements.
spatial-ub6749c29bf95907003-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u821664adbb31d63293-1.text: The classification of settlements identifies anchor settlements with different primary functions according to their role in achieving spatial development priorities and determines the main tasks for supporting their development.
spatial-u821664adbb31d63293-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u7994c072d060a18a54-1.text: The unified list of anchor settlements is intended to concentrate instruments and resources to help achieve the national goals, including reducing disparities in the socioeconomic development of the country’s territories.
spatial-u7994c072d060a18a54-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u7fef7da84e36c65034-1.text: Anchor settlements where new investment projects with a substantial impact on the economy are being implemented are regarded in the Strategy as prospective centers of economic growth.
spatial-u7fef7da84e36c65034-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-uf0f827bde267fbdd52-1.text: The main development tasks for anchor settlements are:
spatial-uf0f827bde267fbdd52-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u65531ce621fb36e786-1.text: for settlements where new investment projects with a substantial impact on the economy are being implemented: advance development of transport and energy infrastructure, including deployment of energy-saving and energy-efficient technologies, to support investment projects; housing construction and the creation of utilities and social infrastructure, including to attract personnel; and the use of territorial development instruments, including to support high-technology sectors and investment projects important for achieving the technological sovereignty of the Russian Federation;
spatial-u65531ce621fb36e786-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u0ae20dbb1a92489bbd-1.text: for settlements ensuring the national security of the Russian Federation and serving critical infrastructure, and for science cities: ensuring a living environment of sufficient quality to retain and increase the population, including through infrastructure development instruments aimed at diversifying the economies of the territories concerned, alongside developing cooperation chains needed to improve the resilience and operating efficiency of the enterprises and other facilities that give the settlements their strategic importance; and supporting higher and secondary vocational education infrastructure and scientific and technological projects in the settlements;
spatial-u0ae20dbb1a92489bbd-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u38c24ec1156ca5aa00-1.text: for settlements within urban agglomerations and administrative centers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation outside urban agglomerations: improving economic efficiency through concentration (densification) of economic activity and development of agglomeration and interregional economic ties; ensuring scientific, technological and innovative development; providing investment projects with transport and social infrastructure; creating conditions for active housing construction; and improving the reliability of electricity supply to consumers, including through infrastructure-based territorial development instruments aimed at bringing former industrial sites into economic use, taking account of historically established economic specialization;
spatial-u38c24ec1156ca5aa00-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u0853b42f00a7b2e3b1-1.text: for settlements serving as the main centers providing medical care, education and cultural services and meeting other needs of residents of adjacent territories: developing the relevant infrastructure with account taken of the population of the adjacent territory, in order to reduce population outflows from small and medium-sized cities and rural settlements.
spatial-u0853b42f00a7b2e3b1-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u5b3cd95a2ca47a0815-1.text: The unified list of anchor settlements identifies anchor settlements, including single-industry towns, at risk of socioeconomic deterioration, including rising unemployment and the closure or liquidation of major enterprises, including city-forming enterprises, caused by unlawful unilateral restrictive measures by unfriendly states, declining demand for the products of major enterprises or other adverse factors.
spatial-u5b3cd95a2ca47a0815-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u0974051e49f4812d13-1.text: The socioeconomic situation of anchor settlements is monitored to identify settlements at risk of socioeconomic deterioration and develop measures to manage those risks.
spatial-u0974051e49f4812d13-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u8eb4e2f84a6ad851be-1.text: Risk management measures may include remedying damage when production facilities close, assistance with relocation or retraining, encouraging diversification of settlements’ economies and improving investment attractiveness.
spatial-u8eb4e2f84a6ad851be-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-u9c69c87b38bb9beadf-1.text: Anchor settlements receive support measures on a priority basis, taking account of their main development tasks. Provisions giving priority to financing measures (projects) in anchor settlements are integrated into the processes of preparing state programs, granting subsidies from the federal budget and providing other support measures.
spatial-u9c69c87b38bb9beadf-1.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

spatial-ubae9bfe9ee8fa60b78-1.text: Territorial planning is a key mechanism for implementing the Strategy’s priorities, ensuring alignment of budget expenditure with spatial development priorities, including linkage to the development tasks of anchor settlements and geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation and the main development directions of the federal districts of the Russian Federation and the Arctic Zone of the Russian Federation.

spatial-ua3b4a9315be56b385e-1.text: Budget expenditure is aligned with spatial development priorities through up-to-date territorial planning documents, including territorial planning schemes of the Russian Federation in various fields and territorial planning schemes of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, which inform the preparation and adjustment of state programs, investment programs of natural monopolies and other program documents.

spatial-uf626e43f3826a56871-1.text: Unified sectoral classifications of facilities of federal and regional significance are used in preparing territorial planning documents.

spatial-ud739b386d918f21787-1.text: Financing and commencement of construction of facilities of federal and regional significance must be permitted only where those facilities are included in territorial planning documents at the corresponding level.

spatial-ucef3881432c8e28ff7-1.text: The digital foundation for implementing the Strategy is the digital platform, through which the following are carried out:

spatial-u3c7c4d0b3d15c230d4-1.text: classification of settlements, including determination and updating of the unified list of anchor settlements;

spatial-u64b069a1ea53f92e1b-1.text: monitoring and determination of mechanisms of federal support for constituent entities of the Russian Federation;

spatial-u6db24e6d66c018019d-1.text: monitoring the socioeconomic development of territories, including systematization of data on existing and planned infrastructure and major investment projects;

spatial-u81d9b50a823e6f9407-1.text: assessment of infrastructure provision, taking account of demographic forecasts, planned investment projects and other factors;

spatial-u790ed4ce973290120b-1.text: systematization of data on the environmental condition and economic use of marine areas to support marine spatial planning;

spatial-u7bb23af725bd386d54-1.text: providing access to educational programs for municipal servants;

spatial-u1f7ae4d0fbe9e319f6-1.text: The digital platform also uses the functionality of electronic services of the federal state geographic information system “Unified Digital Platform ‘National Spatial Data System’”, including that information system’s mapping component.

spatial-uf379b537bc2c50ac09-1.text: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
spatial-uf379b537bc2c50ac09-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-ub92b9de64bc5e02bf4-1.text: Other mechanisms for implementing the Strategy include:
spatial-ub92b9de64bc5e02bf4-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-ubda360ee12fc516d4d-1.text: an integrated plan for developing transport, energy, telecommunications, social and other infrastructure up to 2036, through which the development of different types of infrastructure is coordinated;
spatial-ubda360ee12fc516d4d-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u87169e90482d602d16-1.text: the transport and economic balance of the Russian Federation, on the basis of which transport projects are prioritized according to their socioeconomic effects;
spatial-u87169e90482d602d16-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u65830bcce15aef6eb8-1.text: a 5-year forecast of the Russian Federation economy’s personnel needs by type of economic activity and constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
spatial-u65830bcce15aef6eb8-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-uca0f56b9408a54e910-1.text: investment programs of natural monopolies approved through coordination with federal executive bodies and executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including in economic sectors where that approval procedure is not regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
spatial-uca0f56b9408a54e910-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-ue6fd98c302732f8e72-1.text: a developed regulatory legal framework governing marine spatial planning, which will interlink development planning for marine areas and coastal territories;
spatial-ue6fd98c302732f8e72-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u0d5a9eab20fad50ff0-1.text: a spatial analysis center providing methodological support, monitoring implementation and adjusting the Strategy.
spatial-u0d5a9eab20fad50ff0-1.locator: Other Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-uc3d720fb737dc13549-1.text: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
spatial-uc3d720fb737dc13549-1.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u6dbd256c49789af81c-1.text: The management model for implementing the Strategy comprises a set of interrelated mechanisms and is intended to ensure effective achievement of the Strategy’s goals.
spatial-u6dbd256c49789af81c-1.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u379e234643db3c1d22-1.text: The Strategy is implemented by federal executive bodies, executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and state budget-funded institutions subordinate to them through legal, policy, organizational, information, production and other measures within their assigned powers.
spatial-u379e234643db3c1d22-1.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-u6ab6b4bf41f374108f-1.text: Spatial development is managed using digital technologies. The digital platform is the key element of the management model for implementing the Strategy.
spatial-u6ab6b4bf41f374108f-1.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy

spatial-uf63bf4c41adecf3f47-1.text: The Strategy’s main provisions and spatial development target indicators are taken into account when determining, in the unified plan for achieving the national goals, planned values of indicators used to assess the effectiveness of the highest officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and of their executive bodies, characterizing achievement of the national-goal indicators.
spatial-uf63bf4c41adecf3f47-1.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
